observations: Photo shows a full bicycle with front suspension fork and disc brakes (rotors visible).
No readable brand/model text in the photo.
No close-ups of the drivetrain (shifters/derailleur/cassette) to confirm 18-speed.
No close-ups of brake pads/rotors condition to confirm “perfect” brakes.

claims.claim: High quality bicycle, with 18 speed gears and shock absorbers
claims.evidence: Photo shows front suspension, but does not confirm 18-speed (no clear view of shifter/derailleur/cassette or speed markings).
No receipt/date/serial proof shown in photo.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: Photo suggests cleanliness, but cannot confirm brake/gear performance, rust absence, or originality from one angle.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.”
claims.evidence: Seller’s statement only; no new photos/videos to verify shifting/braking or rust/original parts.

risks.risk: Speed/gear count may not be 18 as claimed.
risks.proof: Close-up of rear derailleur + cassette/freewheel and shifter (or a video shifting through all gears).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used bicycle with unknown gear count (worst case vs 18-speed claim).

risks.risk: Brakes may need service despite claim of “perfect”.
risks.proof: Video of braking from a short roll + close-up of brake pads and both rotors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not guaranteed (worst case: needs basic brake service).

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical issues (wheel wobble, fork/frame alignment) not visible in one photo.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels straight-on (rim wobble) and fork crown/frame alignment; short ride video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used condition with possible minor alignment/wheel issues.

risks.proof: Close-ups of drivetrain markings (crank/derailleur/cassette) and any brand labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed original parts.

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion may exist on chain/bolt heads not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up of chain and chainrings + bolt heads; wipe/spot check photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require cleaning/lubrication and minor corrosion treatment.

proof_requests: Rear derailleur + cassette/freewheel close-up showing speed/gear setup (or a clear video shifting through all gears).
Brake proof: short roll braking video + close-ups of brake pads and both rotors.
Wheel/fork/frame alignment: straight-on wheel photos (rim wobble) and fork crown/frame close-ups.
Drivetrain originality: close-ups of crank/derailleur/cassette markings.
Chain/bolt rust check: close-up of chain and bolt heads.
response.reason: The seller’s “tested yesterday” claim is not verifiable remotely without new evidence. With only one photo, the key pricing factors (exact 18-speed setup and brake condition) can’t be confirmed, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
